title: Jointly Controlled Entities–Non-Monetary Contributions by Venturers
summary: Addressed how a venturer should account for gains or losses on contributing non-monetary assets to a jointly controlled entity. Superseded in 2013 by IFRS 11.

related.title: Joint Arrangements
related.relationship: The standard that superseded SIC-13 in 2013 by restructuring joint arrangements into joint operations and joint ventures

related.title: Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures
related.relationship: Now addresses equity-method accounting for joint ventures, replacing SIC-13's specific contribution guidance
